==Description==
'''UI-5'' is the 1st entity you may encounter within [[Section Interchange]], more info below.

==Behavior==
Once '''UI-5''' spawns, it will spawn behind the player and make its presence known by a composition known as "Horror Race", which can be heard globally. It will very slowly make its way towards the current room. UI-5 is overall a very slow entity, and it's not a very huge threat. Once '''UI-5''' reaches the current room's door, it will then despawn. '''UI-5''' will also emit a laughing noise when players are near it.
==Strategy & Tips==
* '''UI-5''' isn't a huge threat, as it doesn't check any hiding spots and it's very slow. Therefore, it is very easy to deal with.
** Hide in any hiding spot that's available once you hear it.

* '''UI-5''' is very slow, however it may become a threat later on the further you go, considering its laughing can only be heard within close proximity, which means that if you aren't paying attention and you're not near a hiding spot, you may be killed by the entity.
* '''UI-5''' is very slow, however it may become a threat later on the further you go, considering its laughing can only be heard within close proximity, which means that if you aren't paying attention and you're not near a hiding spot, you may be killed by the entity.
** You can actually hug the nearby walls to easily avoid '''UI-5''', only use this method as a last resort since lockers are pretty much everywhere in every room.

==Trivia==
* '''UI-5''' comes from a game known as INTERMINABLE ROOMS within its 2023 April Fools Event.
* '''UI-5''''s appearance comes from SCP-087-B, known as "The Haunted Staircase".
* It is also featured in many other horror games, like Rooms: Found Footage:RENOVATED.
* Unlike most entities using a directional image to display its appearance, '''UI-5''' uses an invisible block with decals on all sides, giving the entity a straightforward, yet goofy appearance.
